resolved.title: 逻辑运算符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Logical Operators[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Logical operators[/b] are used to combine two or more conditions.

The [b]logical AND &&[/b] operator returns [b]true[/b] only when both conditions are [b]true[/b]. 

The [b]logical OR ||[/b] operator returns true when one (or both) of the conditions are true.

The [b]logical NOT ! [/b]operator returns true when the condition is false (basically reversing the result of the condition).

[s0l0!-header][b]Some examples:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" codeId="3309"]x := 42
y := 8
    
// logical AND
fmt.Println(x!=y && x<=y)
    
// logical OR
fmt.Println(x!=y || x<=y)
    
// logical NOT
fmt.Println(!(x>y))[/code]
[note]You can combine multiple conditions and use parentheses to group them, such as: [b]((x > 0 && x < 100) || x == 42) [/b][/note]

content.text:
**逻辑运算符**用于组合两个或多个条件。

- 与逻辑运算符`&&`: 只有当两个条件都是**true**时，才返回**true**；
- 或逻辑运算符`||`: 当一个（或两个）条件为**true**时，返回**true**；
- 非逻辑运算符`!`: 条件为**false**时返回**true**，类似反转条件；
content.text_html:
Logical operators are used to combine two or more conditions.

The logical AND && operator returns true only when both conditions are true.

The logical OR || operator returns true when one (or both) of the conditions are true.

The **logical NOT ! **operator returns true when the condition is false (basically reversing the result of the condition).

Some examples:

逻辑运算符用于组合两个或多个条件。

只有当两个条件都是真时，逻辑运算符AND &&才会返回真**。

当一个（或两个）条件为真时，**逻辑OR ||**运算符返回真。

逻辑上的NOT !**操作符在条件为假时返回真（基本上是反转了条件的结果）。
